item.title: Self-Hosted Container Log Rotation Management: Docker JSON-File vs Logrotate vs Fluent Bit
item.description: Container logs grow without bounds unless actively managed. A single busy web server container can generate gigabytes of log data per day through stdout/stderr output, access logs, and application debug messages. Without proper rotation policies, container logs consume all available disk space, causing container crashes, host instability, and data loss.

item.title: Self-Hosted Elasticsearch Operations: Curator vs ECK vs ElastAlert 2
item.description: Running Elasticsearch in production requires more than just starting the service. Index lifecycle management, cluster orchestration, automated alerting, and backup strategies are all essential for a reliable search and analytics platform. While Elasticsearch provides powerful built-in capabilities, the open-source ecosystem offers specialized tools that simplify operations at scale.
